inspection_summary.note: Texas HHSC inspections, report investigations and assessments since October 2017, updated daily.

occurrences.finding: Supervision ensures each child?s safety, well-being, including physical proximity and auditory or visual awareness of each child?s on going activity: During the inspection I observed a child that was unsupervised attempting to leave out of the front door of the operation.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Supervision ensures each child?s safety, well-being, including physical proximity and auditory or visual awareness of each child?s on going activity (26 TAC §746.1205(a)(4))

occurrences.finding: AP Report Child Injury Requiring Medical Treatment by a Health-Care Professional or Hospitalization: Based on evidence obtained during the DFPS investigation, there is sufficient evidence to support the allegations that the operation did not notify Child Care Regulation of a child that was injured while in care.
occurrences.violation_type_title: AP Report Child Injury Requiring Medical Treatment by a Health-Care Professional or Hospitalization (26 TAC §746.305(a)(2))

occurrences.finding: Training Requirements for Employees, Caregivers, and Directors - Pediatric First Aid with Rescue Breathing: During inspection, one caregiver had expired pediatric first aid on file.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Training Requirements for Employees, Caregivers, and Directors - Pediatric First Aid with Rescue Breathing (26 TAC §746.1301(a)(3)(A))

occurrences.finding: Required Personnel Records - Required Affidavit (Form 2912): During inspection one caregiver and director did not have pre employment affidavit form 2912 completed.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Personnel Records - Required Affidavit (Form 2912) (26 TAC §746.901(5))

occurrences.finding: Required Admission Information - Emergency Contact: During inspection one child had parent listed for emergency contact on admission form. One child was missing address for emergency contact on admission form.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Admission Information - Emergency Contact (26 TAC §746.605(6))

occurrences.finding: Training Requirements for Employees, Caregivers, and Directors - Transportation training: During inspection, director was observed transporting a child without having annual transportation training.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Training Requirements for Employees, Caregivers, and Directors - Transportation training (26 TAC §746.1301(a)(7)(A))

occurrences.finding: Training Requirements for Employees, Caregivers, and Directors - Pediatric CPR: During inspection, one caregiver had expired pediatric CPR on file.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Training Requirements for Employees, Caregivers, and Directors - Pediatric CPR (26 TAC §746.1301(a)(4)(A))

occurrences.finding: Required Personnel Records - Required Affidavit (Form 2985): During inspection, one staff member did not have notarized affidavit form 2985 on file. Director did not have notarized affidavit form 2985 present at the time of inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Personnel Records - Required Affidavit (Form 2985) (26 TAC §746.901(4))

occurrences.finding: Annual Sanitation Inspection: At time of follow up, health inspection was last conducted on 1/31/2024.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Annual Sanitation Inspection (26 TAC §746.3401(a))

occurrences.finding: Annual Fire Inspection - Before Initial Permit Issued and Every 12 Months: At time of follow up, a fire inspection was last conducted 7/15/2024.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Annual Fire Inspection - Before Initial Permit Issued and Every 12 Months (26 TAC §746.5101(a))

occurrences.finding: Safety Requirements for Active Play Equipment - No Entanglement Protrusions or Openings: One of the three playground observed had openings and exposed screws on the railing of the stairs on play equipment.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Safety Requirements for Active Play Equipment - No Entanglement Protrusions or Openings (26 TAC §746.4601(4))

occurrences.finding: Maintenance of Building, Grounds and Equipment: On one of the three playgrounds observed, a fence was broken and missing planks. Stationary car had a missing steering wheel and the bottom has a hole.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Maintenance of Building, Grounds and Equipment (26 TAC §746.3407)

occurrences.finding: Child/Caregiver Ratio - 12 or Fewer Children: Based on sign in and out sheets. On 7/29/2025 there was one caregiver in the entire building with 12 children. The youngest child was 13 months and the oldest was 9 years old. Classroom was over ratio by one child.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Child/Caregiver Ratio - 12 or Fewer Children (26 TAC §746.1701)

occurrences.finding: Report Change in Director: Based on call logs from 7/8/2025 and 7/28/2025. Owner contacted Child Care Regulation via phone and did not send written notification within five days of director change.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Report Change in Director (26 TAC §746.303(a)(4))

occurrences.finding: Designating Director: The operation failed to designate a director in the appropriate amount of time.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Designating Director (26 TAC §746.201(4))

occurrences.finding: Designating Director: The operation failed to designate a director in the appropriate amount of time.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Designating Director (26 TAC §746.201(4))

occurrences.finding: Adequate Lighting During Naptime: The nap room for children older than 18 months was excessively dark and children could not be seen when first entering the room.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Adequate Lighting During Naptime (26 TAC §746.2911)

occurrences.finding: Arrangement of Napping Equipment -All Children Supervised: The children's mats were arranged with walls blocking the caregiver from adequately observing them from the caregiver's position on one side of the room.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Arrangement of Napping Equipment -All Children Supervised (26 TAC §746.2909(5))

occurrences.finding: Required Records Maintained and Made Available - Safety Documentation for Emergency Drills, Fire Extinguishers, & Smoke Detectors: The operation could not access the electronic record showing that the emergency practice checklist had been conducted for November and December.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Records Maintained and Made Available - Safety Documentation for Emergency Drills, Fire Extinguishers, & Smoke Detectors (26 TAC §746.801(10))

occurrences.finding: Responsibilities of Caregivers - Know children's names and ages: The caregiver in charge did not know the ages of the children and stated that she could not access the ages of the children without leaving them unattended.    This was corrected when a conversation was had with the owner and a plan was made for keeping track of children during opening and closing hours in the future.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Responsibilities of Caregivers - Know children's names and ages (26 TAC §746.1205(a)(3))

occurrences.finding: Active Play Surfacing In Use Zones - Loose Fill or Unitary Surfacing: A Little Tykes plastic slide was set up in an area that did not have loose fill surfacing.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Active Play Surfacing In Use Zones - Loose Fill or Unitary Surfacing (26 TAC §746.4901(a))

occurrences.finding: AP Background check results - Must receive notification prior to allowing subject to be present at your operation: An employee was present at the inspection whose active and eligible background check had been inactivated.    This was corrected when the employee was sent home immediately by the director.
occurrences.violation_type_title: AP Background check results - Must receive notification prior to allowing subject to be present at your operation (26 TAC §745.641)

occurrences.finding: Written Operational Policies - Vaccine Preventable Diseases: Upon inspection, the operational policies still  did not include a section on vaccine preventable immunizations for employees.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Written Operational Policies - Vaccine Preventable Diseases (26 TAC §746.501(a)(28))

occurrences.finding: Written Operational Policies - Preventing and Responding to Abuse and Neglect: Upon inspection, the operational policies section on Abuse and Neglect was still not comprehensive according to minimum standards.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Written Operational Policies - Preventing and Responding to Abuse and Neglect (26 TAC §746.501(a)(26))

occurrences.finding: Written Operational Policies - Promotion of Physical Activity: Upon inspection, the operatonal policies still did not include a section on the promotion of indoor/outdoor activities.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Written Operational Policies - Promotion of Physical Activity (26 TAC §746.501(a)(18))

occurrences.finding: Written Operational Policies - Preventing and Responding to Abuse and Neglect: The operatonal policies section on Abuse and Neglect is not comprehensive according to minimum standards.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Written Operational Policies - Preventing and Responding to Abuse and Neglect (26 TAC §746.501(a)(26))

occurrences.finding: Required Records Maintained and Made Available - Children's Product Certification: The operation did not have an up to date and signed Children's Products Certification Form.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Records Maintained and Made Available - Children's Product Certification (26 TAC §746.801(18))

occurrences.finding: Written Operational Policies - Vaccine Preventable Diseases: The operational policies do not include a section on vaccine preventable immunizations for employees.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Written Operational Policies - Vaccine Preventable Diseases (26 TAC §746.501(a)(28))

occurrences.finding: Diaper Changing Equipment - Hand-washing Sink in Diaper Changing Area: There was no sink in the diaper changing area of the two year old room.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Diaper Changing Equipment - Hand-washing Sink in Diaper Changing Area (26 TAC §746.3503(d))

occurrences.finding: Active Play Surfacing In Use Zones - Loose Fill or Unitary Surfacing: There is no loose fill in the use zones of the swings
occurrences.violation_type_title: Active Play Surfacing In Use Zones - Loose Fill or Unitary Surfacing (26 TAC §746.4901(a))

occurrences.finding: Written Operational Policies - Promotion of Physical Activity: The operatonal policies do not include a section on the promotion of indoor/outdoor activities.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Written Operational Policies - Promotion of Physical Activity (26 TAC §746.501(a)(18))
